label: Create a page about Moody College benefits
prompt: Create a page of blocks that describe the benefits of Moody College in [current year]

label: Create a showcase from uploaded images
prompt: Create a Showcase block using the uploaded images and write strong, accessible alt text and captions for each item

label: Create a hero for this page
prompt: Create a Moody Hero block for this page with a strong headline, supporting copy, and a call to action that fits the page topic

label: Create a standard page plan
prompt: Plan a new standard page for this topic and suggest the best sequence of blocks to build it clearly and persuasively

label: Create a student recruitment page
prompt: Create a page of blocks aimed at prospective students explaining why they should choose Moody College in [current year]

label: Summarize attached files into blocks
prompt: Use the attached files to create a page structure and draft blocks that summarize the most important information clearly for web readers

label: Revise the existing hero
prompt: Revise the existing hero on this page to make the headline sharper, the supporting copy more concise, and the call to action more compelling

label: Improve the tone of this page
prompt: Review the blocks on this page and suggest edits that make the tone clearer, more confident, and more engaging for prospective students

label: Turn this into a news-style page
prompt: Create a page of blocks that presents this topic in a news-style format with a strong lead, supporting sections, and clear calls to action

label: Make a faculty-focused page
prompt: Create a page of blocks highlighting faculty expertise, research strengths, and student opportunities related to this topic

label: Refresh an existing block
prompt: Edit an existing block on this page to improve clarity, tighten the copy, and make the content feel more modern and editorial

label: Build a promo unit section
prompt: Create a Promo Unit section with strong, valid content items that highlight key opportunities, resources, or reasons to engage with Moody College

label: Create a page for parents and families
prompt: Create a page of blocks for parents and families that explains the value of Moody College, student support, and career outcomes in [current year]

label: Create a page from this topic
prompt: Using the current page context, create a well-structured page of blocks that explains this topic clearly from introduction through next steps
